cohort: The study included 36 preterm small-for-gestational-age (SGA) neonates and 36 preterm appropriate-for-gestational-age (AGA) neonates, with 18 neonates in each group having a haemodynamically significant patent ductus arteriosus (hsPDA).
finding: Contrary to the hypothesis, hsPDA significantly reduced regional cerebral oxygen saturation (rScO2) and increased cerebral fractional tissue oxygen extraction (cFTOE) in preterm SGA neonates.
